observed_failure.reason: proposed next state requests implementation AI without explicit implementation scope

root_cause: Semantic provider output can select a valid non-economic research action yet omit or mis-encode the routing wrapper needed by Runtime V2. The old bridge treated a routing-format omission as a new semantic failure, causing repeated provider calls without changing the underlying research choice.
repair: Normalize routing-only provider output before proposal validation while preserving semantic decision fields.
Inject a bounded canonical implementation_scope when implementation AI is selected but the wrapper is omitted.
Convert invalid/unavailable deterministic-operation guesses to bounded implementation AI only when no semantic, data, CI, economic, or cTrader route applies.
Bump provider version so the repaired contract receives a fresh request fingerprint.
Regression-test both missing-scope and invalid deterministic-ref cases.
